abstract: Levels of human pregnancy-specific or trophoblast-specific beta1-globulin (TBG) were measured by double-antibody radioimmunoassay (RIA) in 103 patients with trophoblastic tumours and in 114 patients with a variety of non-trophoblastic tumours. The sensitivity of RIA for TBG was about 1 ng per ml. Twenty healthy adult females and males had levels below 1 ng per ml. Using the RIA for measurement of TBG in sera which were selected from immunodiffusion-TBG-negative samples, we detected elevated TBG levels in 76.7% of cases with trophoblastic tumours and in 15% of different cases with non-trophoblastic malignancies. The diagnostic and prognostic significance of the measurement of TBG levels by RIA in patients with trophoblastic tumours is discussed.
abstract_ja: ヒト妊娠特異的あるいは栄養膜特異的β1グロブリン(TBG)の血清中濃度を、栄養膜性腫瘍患者103例および多様な非栄養膜性腫瘍患者114例において二抗体放射免疫測定法(RIA)により測定した。TBGに対するRIAの感度は約1 ng/mlであった。健康な成人男女20名の値はいずれも1 ng/ml未満であった。免疫拡散法でTBG陰性とされた血清を対象としてRIAでTBGを測定したところ、栄養膜性腫瘍症例の76.7%、非栄養膜性悪性腫瘍の別症例の15%で上昇したTBG値が検出された。RIAによるTBG値測定の、栄養膜性腫瘍患者における診断的および予後的意義について考察する。
